title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::

items.text: We have two main school vacations.
One is in the summer and the other is in the winter.
Summer vacation begins in July and winter vacation begins in December.
During vacations I don't go to school.
I have a lot of free time.
I spend summer vacation a little different from winter vacation.
During the summer vacation I usually go on a short trip with my family.
During the last summer vacation I went to the East Sea Beach.
I enjoyed swimming in the sea.
During the last winter vacation I went on a short ski trip.
My father taught my brother and I how to ski.
We had a really great time at the ski resort.
I have been learning English for three years.
My English teacher is from Canada.
He has been telling us a lot about his country.
I would love to go there on my next vacation.
